state:
**Goal `ext-compiler`, Stage 3 (the call) is under way.** Stages 1 and 2 are on disk. The design is ADR 0246 § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. This goal has no record slot.

`nvs_ext::convert` (behind `engine`) turns a `Value` (the host's view of a Novis value) into the `wasmtime::component::Val` its `NovisType` crosses as, and back, for every row of `rule:packaging/a-value-crosses-as-its-wit-type`'s table except `resource` and `mixed`. The named rows are on disk: a manifest's `enums` and `unions` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs` module doc owns their rules, including the "cases told apart by their keys" check), `Manifest::novis_type` resolves them, `nvs_ext::types::CORE_CLASSES` is the one list of `Core` value classes that cross (`crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs` holds it to `wit/nvs-ext/types.wit`, fields included), and the loader matches each against the export's `enum`, `variant` or record. `crates/nvs-ext/tests/convert.rs` loads its guest through `Loader::load_bytes`, so every row is also checked against the WIT; 7 of the check's 9 tests exist and pass.

The checker (`crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs`) types a union as the union of its shapes and a `Core` value class as that class, and leaves out a method or constant whose type names an extension enum: the enum has no class in the program yet.

Not reading the set yet: `nvs serve`'s `script::Compiler`, `nvs test` and the language server (Stage 6). A program calling an extension type-checks and then reaches `nvs-ir`, which has no lowering for the call.

Fixture gaps, Stage 3's: the named rows are absent from the conformance fixture under `tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/`, and `kindOf` (`mixed`) is never called.

items.text: **`mixed` and `resource`**: a `mixed` argument as a `borrow<value>` into a per-call handle table read through the accessor imports, and an extension `resource` kept by the request and dropped at its end. Tests `a_mixed_argument_crosses_as_a_value_handle_read_through_accessors` and `an_extension_resource_is_dropped_when_its_request_ends`. Anchors `crates/nvs-ext/src/convert.rs:122`, `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:471`. `rule:packaging/values-cross-as-handles`.

**The trampoline call in `nvs-ir`**: a static call whose target is an extension class lowers to a direct call of its export's trampoline. Test `an_extension_static_call_lowers_to_a_direct_call_of_its_export_trampoline` under `cargo test -p nvs-ir`. Anchor `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs:1`. `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.

backlog: An extension enum as a class the program can name (`<class namespace>\<Name>`), so `ext_lib` types a method that uses one: `crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs` module doc.
The two end-to-end cases under `tests/conformance/ext/` (an `--EXTENSION--` section loading the fixture), and the named rows added to that fixture: goal file, Stage 3.
Stage 4's qualifier checks and the `secret`-return refusal: goal file, Stage 4.
Stage 5's source section through `autoload`: goal file, Stage 5.
Stage 6: `nvs serve`'s `script::Compiler`, `nvs test` and the language server read the set: `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.
`bytes` crosses as one `Val::U8` per byte until the trampoline lowers through a typed function: `nvs_ext::convert`'s module doc.
